title: Strata
subtitle: Whole-model inference engine for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on this machine.
idleHint: To serve a model with Strata, open Deploy, choose the Strata inference service and a qwen4exp model, and deploy it on this machine.
unreachable: The plugin did not answer. Check that it is active on this machine.
earlierStageHint: This machine runs an earlier stage of a model split across machines: Strata's engine alone, which hands its layers' work to the next machine. Strata's app, with the chat and the monitor, is on the machine of the last stage, which serves the requests.
